title: The last Monday of September is a quiet deadline
dek: Three months are left in the year, and most of us are only now noticing how fast the fall arrived.
body: Tonight is the last Monday of September. It does not feel like a big date, but it is one. On Wednesday the calendar turns to October, and the year starts its final quarter.
Most of us made a list in January. Some of it got done. A lot of it got moved to "after summer," and summer is now officially over.

I do not think the answer is to panic and try to finish everything by December. I think the answer is to pick one thing from that list that still matters and give it the next ninety days. One thing is enough to make this a year you are proud of.
So tonight, before the week gets away from you, write down that one thing. Then go to bed a little earlier than usual. October will still be there in the morning.
